Transporters may lift a span anywhere along its length as long as total weight is within capacity.
Temporary towers carry only vertical load; horizontal forces during travel are negligible.
quiz.explanation: 平鈑試驗 s = q·B·(1 − ν²)·I/E。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Plate-load test s = q·B·(1 − ν²)·I/E. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 行駛路徑預壓試驗與試行：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Proof testing and trial run of the travel path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平鈑載重試驗與試行」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plate-load test and trial run” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿路徑每隔固定距離及所有可疑位置做平鈑試驗，結果繪成承載分布圖；試行時在路面測點量測前後高程，與估算沉陷比較，超過預設值的位置加強後重測；試行同時演練通訊、緊急停車與撤離。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run plate-load tests at fixed intervals along the path and at every suspect location, plotting a bearing map; during the trial run survey road points before and after, compare with estimated settlement and strengthen and retest any location exceeding the preset value; rehearse communications, emergency stops and evacuation at the same time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預壓試驗與試行是正式運輸前的停留點，結果須經運輸工程師與設計單位確認；試行發現的問題與修正措施列入運輸計畫的最終版。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Proof testing and the trial run are hold points before the real move, with results confirmed by the transport engineer and designer; problems found and fixes made are written into the final transport plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略試行，正式運輸時在路徑轉彎處遇到未壓實的回填土，軸線下陷使橋體傾斜，被迫停車補強，封閉時段大幅延長；轉向演練不足則可能讓懸臂端碰撞路旁設施。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping the trial run means meeting uncompacted backfill at a bend during the real move; axle lines sink, the span tilts and the fleet must stop for strengthening, greatly extending the closure; too little steering rehearsal can let an overhang strike roadside structures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「行駛路徑預壓試驗與試行」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Proof testing and trial run of the travel path"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

Run plate-load tests at fixed intervals along the path and at every suspect location, plotting a bearing map.
If SPMTs can move a span in tens of minutes, the whole replacement must finish within hours.
quiz.explanation: 沿路徑每隔固定距離及所有可疑位置做平鈑試驗，結果繪成承載分布圖；試行時在路面測點量測前後高程，與估算沉陷比較，超過預設值的位置加強後重測；試行同時演練通訊、緊急停車與撤離。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run plate-load tests at fixed intervals along the path and at every suspect location, plotting a bearing map; during the trial run survey road points before and after, compare with estimated settlement and strengthen and retest any location exceeding the preset value; rehearse communications, emergency stops and evacuation at the same time. steps.title: 行駛路徑預壓試驗與試行：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Proof testing and trial run of the travel path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平鈑載重試驗與試行」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Plate-load test and trial run” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略試行，正式運輸時在路徑轉彎處遇到未壓實的回填土，軸線下陷使橋體傾斜，被迫停車補強，封閉時段大幅延長；轉向演練不足則可能讓懸臂端碰撞路旁設施。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping the trial run means meeting uncompacted backfill at a bend during the real move; axle lines sink, the span tilts and the fleet must stop for strengthening, greatly extending the closure; too little steering rehearsal can let an overhang strike roadside structures. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：FHWA 手冊的荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 案例以 134 軸線移動逾 3,600 噸的兩跨橋，手冊特別指出成功依靠良好的地盤準備與平整路面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In the FHWA manual's Badhoevedorp A4/A5 case in the Netherlands, 134 axle lines moved a two-span bridge of more than 3,600 tons, and the manual notes that success depended on good ground preparation and level surfaces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地質報告合格就代表行駛路徑一定能承受運輸荷載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A satisfactory geotechnical report guarantees the route can take the transport load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略試行，正式運輸時在路徑轉彎處遇到未壓實的回填土，軸線下陷使橋體傾斜，被迫停車補強，封閉時段大幅延長；轉向演練不足則可能讓懸臂端碰撞路旁設施。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「行駛路徑預壓試驗與試行」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Proof testing and trial run of the travel path" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
SPMT 換橋只是換上部結構，下部結構可以照舊不必評估。
省略試行，正式運輸時在路徑轉彎處遇到未壓實的回填土，軸線下陷使橋體傾斜，被迫停車補強，封閉時段大幅延長；轉向演練不足則可能讓懸臂端碰撞路旁設施。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An SPMT replacement only swaps the superstructure, so the substructure needs no assessment.
Skipping the trial run means meeting uncompacted backfill at a bend during the real move.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估」與「成效評估、紀錄與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure" and "Benefit evaluation, records and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「既有下部結構承載」如何影響自行式模組運輸車換橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Existing substructure capacity” governs force, deformation or durability in “SPMT bridge replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SPMT 換橋常保留既有橋台與橋墩，只更換上部結構，但新橋可能更長、更寬或更重：FHWA 手冊的 Graves Avenue 案例中，新跨約 143 ft、重約 1,300 噸，取代的舊中跨僅約 70.5 ft、約 250 噸。下部結構必須以新反力重新評估承載、耐震與耐久，包括混凝土劣化、鋼筋腐蝕、基礎沖刷與支承座強度。新舊混凝土的接縫、伸縮縫與排水細部也要重新設計，否則換了新橋，水仍沿舊縫滲入下部結構。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「既有下部結構承載」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPMT replacements often keep the existing abutments and piers and replace only the superstructure, but the new span may be longer, wider or heavier: in the FHWA manual's Graves Avenue case the new spans were about 143 ft long and about 1,300 tons, replacing an old middle span of about 70.5 ft and about 250 tons. The substructure must be re-assessed for the new reactions in capacity, seismic performance and durability, including concrete deterioration, reinforcement corrosion, foundation scour and seat strength. Joints between new and old concrete, expansion joints and drainage must also be redesigned, or water will keep seeping along old joints into the substructure under the new span. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Existing substructure capacity” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：舊跨 4,000 kN 每端反力 2,000 kN，新跨 10,000 kN 每端 5,000 kN，增為 2.5 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An old 4,000 kN span gives 2,000 kN per end; a new 10,000 kN span gives 5,000 kN, 2.5 times as much.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「SPMT 換橋只是換上部結構，下部結構可以照舊不必評估。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An SPMT replacement only swaps the superstructure, so the substructure needs no assessment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「既有下部結構承載」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Existing substructure capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：舊跨 4,000 kN 每端反力 2,000 kN，新跨 10,000 kN 每端 5,000 kN，增為 2.5 倍。若既有基樁每支容許 800 kN、原有 4 支共 3,200 kN，已不足 5,000 kN，需補樁或新建橋台。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An old 4,000 kN span gives 2,000 kN per end; a new 10,000 kN span gives 5,000 kN, 2.5 times as much. If the existing piles are rated 800 kN each and four give 3,200 kN, they cannot carry 5,000 kN, so added piles or a new abutment are needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計前完成下部結構詳細檢測：鑽心取樣測強度與氯離子、保護層與鋼筋腐蝕調查、基礎與沖刷評估，並以新反力重新計算；若下部結構需補強，補強應在封閉前完成並驗收，避免在封閉期間處理未知問題。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before design, complete a detailed substructure survey: cores for strength and chloride, cover and corrosion surveys, and foundation and scour assessment, then recalculate with the new reactions; any substructure strengthening must be finished and accepted before the closure rather than dealing with unknowns during it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 舊跨 4,000 kN 每端反力 2,000 kN，新跨 10,000 kN 每端 5,000 kN，增為 2.5 倍。若既有基樁每支容許 800 kN、原有 4 支共 3,200 kN，已不足 5,000 kN，需補樁或新建橋台。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure", which statement holds?
options: SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。
舊跨 4,000 kN 每端反力 2,000 kN，新跨 10,000 kN 每端 5,000 kN，增為 2.5 倍。
SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。
optionsEn: More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference.
An old 4,000 kN span gives 2,000 kN per end; a new 10,000 kN span gives 5,000 kN, 2.5 times as much.
With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks.
quiz.explanation: 舊跨 4,000 kN 每端反力 2,000 kN，新跨 10,000 kN 每端 5,000 kN，增為 2.5 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An old 4,000 kN span gives 2,000 kN per end; a new 10,000 kN span gives 5,000 kN, 2.5 times as much. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有下部結構承載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Existing substructure capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計前完成下部結構詳細檢測：鑽心取樣測強度與氯離子、保護層與鋼筋腐蝕調查、基礎與沖刷評估，並以新反力重新計算；若下部結構需補強，補強應在封閉前完成並驗收，避免在封閉期間處理未知問題。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before design, complete a detailed substructure survey: cores for strength and chloride, cover and corrosion surveys, and foundation and scour assessment, then recalculate with the new reactions; any substructure strengthening must be finished and accepted before the closure rather than dealing with unknowns during it. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主在規劃階段就應決定下部結構的保留、補強或新建策略，並把檢測結果與承載評估納入招標文件；新舊介面的防水與排水細部由設計單位統一負責。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should decide at planning stage whether to keep, strengthen or rebuild the substructure and include the survey results and capacity assessment in the tender; the designer takes single responsibility for waterproofing and drainage details at new-to-old interfaces.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只檢查支承座外觀就沿用舊橋台，新橋反力使老化的台帽在支承下方開裂；舊伸縮縫位置沒有改善排水，數年後台帽與支承仍持續劣化，新上部結構的壽命被舊下部結構拖累。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reusing an old abutment after only a visual check of the seats lets the heavier new reactions crack the aged cap under the bearings; leaving drainage at the old joint unimproved means cap and bearings keep deteriorating, so the old substructure limits the life of the new superstructure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 設計前完成下部結構詳細檢測：鑽心取樣測強度與氯離子、保護層與鋼筋腐蝕調查、基礎與沖刷評估，並以新反力重新計算；若下部結構需補強，補強應在封閉前完成並驗收，避免在封閉期間處理未知問題。
knowledge.textEn: Before design, complete a detailed substructure survey: cores for strength and chloride, cover and corrosion surveys, and foundation and scour assessment, then recalculate with the new reactions; any substructure strengthening must be finished and accepted before the closure rather than dealing with unknowns during it.

knowledge.text: 業主在規劃階段就應決定下部結構的保留、補強或新建策略，並把檢測結果與承載評估納入招標文件；新舊介面的防水與排水細部由設計單位統一負責。

quiz.question: 要驗證「新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.title: 新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有下部結構承載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Existing substructure capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只檢查支承座外觀就沿用舊橋台，新橋反力使老化的台帽在支承下方開裂；舊伸縮縫位置沒有改善排水，數年後台帽與支承仍持續劣化，新上部結構的壽命被舊下部結構拖累。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing an old abutment after only a visual check of the seats lets the heavier new reactions crack the aged cap under the bearings; leaving drainage at the old joint unimproved means cap and bearings keep deteriorating, so the old substructure limits the life of the new superstructure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：新舊混凝土的接縫、伸縮縫與排水細部也要重新設計，否則換了新橋，水仍沿舊縫滲入下部結構。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Joints between new and old concrete, expansion joints and drainage must also be redesigned, or water will keep seeping along old joints into the substructure under the new span.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「SPMT 換橋只是換上部結構，下部結構可以照舊不必評估。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An SPMT replacement only swaps the superstructure, so the substructure needs no assessment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只檢查支承座外觀就沿用舊橋台，新橋反力使老化的台帽在支承下方開裂；舊伸縮縫位置沒有改善排水，數年後台帽與支承仍持續劣化，新上部結構的壽命被舊下部結構拖累。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只檢查支承座外觀就沿用舊橋台，新橋反力使老化的台帽在支承下方開裂；舊伸縮縫位置沒有改善排水，數年後台帽與支承仍持續劣化，新上部結構的壽命被舊下部結構拖累。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

steps.title: 成效評估、紀錄與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Benefit evaluation, records and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「用路人成本與交接紀錄」如何影響自行式模組運輸車換橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。

steps.instruction: SPMT 換橋的設備與預製成本通常較高，其合理性來自用路人延滯、繞道與施工區安全風險的大幅降低，所以工程結束後應以實際封閉時間、交通量與事故紀錄評估成效，作為下一個專案的決策依據。交接時除了新橋的竣工資料，還要保存運輸階段計算、監測資料、地盤試驗與落梁紀錄，因為新橋曾經歷一次與設計不同的受力狀態，日後若在梁端發現裂縫，這些資料是判斷成因的關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「用路人成本與交接紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 成效評估、紀錄與交接：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「用路人成本與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “User cost and handover records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：用路人延滯成本 = 交通量 × 每車延滯時間 × 時間價值。每日 40,000 輛、每車繞道多 10 分鐘、每車小時價值 20 元：每日 40,000×(10/60)×20 ≈ 133,000 元；傳統分階段施工影響 180 天約 2,400 萬元，SPMT 週末封閉 2 天約 27 萬元。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: User delay cost = traffic × delay per vehicle × value of time. With 40,000 vehicles a day, 10 minutes of extra detour each and a value of 20 currency units per vehicle-hour, the daily cost is 40,000×(10/60)×20 ≈ 133,000; 180 days of staged construction cost about 24 million, while a 2-day SPMT weekend closure costs about 270,000. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以封閉前後的交通偵測資料計算實際延滯與繞道量，與規劃階段的預估比較；交接文件清單逐項核對，包括運輸計算、監測原始資料、平鈑試驗、落梁量測、支承與伸縮縫安裝紀錄，由業主驗收簽認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use traffic detector data from before, during and after the closure to compute actual delay and detour volumes and compare with planning estimates; check the handover list item by item, including transport calculations, raw monitoring data, plate tests, set-down measurements and bearing and joint installation records, accepted and signed by the owner.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
